create_timedarray_with_frequency: create a TimedArray with a given frequency, start time, and numpy data array
create_timedarray_with_duration: create a TimedArray initialized with frequency, start time, and duration instead of data
add_timedarrays_inplace: add two TimedArray objects together using in-place addition with overlap handling
convert_seconds_to_index: convert seconds to sample index using the Frequency class to_ind method
extract_timedarray_overlap: extract an overlapping slice of a TimedArray for a given start and duration
